# Export System Enhancement

## Problem

The export dialog lacks color mode options. Users cannot export maps with depth gradient coloring - exports always use section colors. Additionally, PNG export is broken (backend bails with error), and there's no visual feedback during export.

**Current state:**
- SVG/PDF export works via Rust backend (`src-tauri/src/export/image.rs`)
- PNG export fails with "PNG export requires frontend rendering"
- No color mode option in export dialog
- No progress indicator for exports
- ExportPreview component shows section colors only

## Dependencies

**Hard dependencies (must complete first):**
- `fn-10-i64`: Loading Progress Indicator (for export progress UI)
- `fn-5-jef`: Depth Gradient Display (for `getDepthColor` HSL interpolation)

## Scope

**In Scope:**
- Add color mode dropdown (section colors vs depth gradient)
- Add depth color preset selector (thermal, ocean, terrain, grayscale, accessible)
- Fix PNG export via resvg rasterization
- Add depth legend option for exports
- Add 600 DPI option for PNG
- Extend ExportPreview to show depth colors
- Progress indicator during export (using fn-10-i64 infrastructure)
- Comprehensive tests (Rust unit, TypeScript unit, Playwright E2E, WebdriverIO)

**Out of Scope:**
- Viewport region selection (always exports full project extent)
- Batch export (one format at a time)
- Custom color pickers (use presets only)

## Approach

### 1. Rust Depth Color Module
New file: `src-tauri/src/export/depth_colors.rs`

**Depth color presets:**
```rust
pub enum DepthPreset {
    Thermal,    // Blue (#00bfff) → Red (#ff4444)
    Ocean,      // Cyan (#00ffff) → Dark Blue (#0000aa)
    Terrain,    // Green (#00ff00) → Brown (#8b4513)
    Grayscale,  // White (#ffffff) → Black (#000000)
    Accessible, // Yellow (#fde047) → Purple (#7c3aed) - Viridis-inspired
}
```

**HSL interpolation (shortest hue path):**
```rust
pub fn get_depth_color(
    depth: f64,
    min_depth: f64,
    max_depth: f64,
    preset: DepthPreset,
) -> String {
    // Returns hex color string
    // Uses shortest hue path for thermal (red→yellow→green→cyan→blue)
}
```

**Tauri command for preset colors:**
```rust
#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_depth_preset_colors(preset: DepthPreset) -> DepthPresetColors {
    DepthPresetColors {
        shallow: "#00bfff".to_string(),
        deep: "#ff4444".to_string(),
    }
}
```

### 2. Update ExportImageOptions
Add to `src-tauri/src/export/image.rs`:
```rust
pub struct ExportImageOptions {
    // ... existing fields
    pub color_mode: ColorMode,          // NEW: 'section' | 'depth'
    pub depth_preset: Option<DepthPreset>, // NEW: preset when depth mode
    pub include_legend: bool,           // NEW: include depth legend
}

pub enum ColorMode {
    Section,
    Depth,
}
```

### 3. PNG Rasterization with resvg
Add `resvg` dependency to `Cargo.toml`:
```toml
resvg = "0.44"
```

Update `export_image()` in `image.rs`:
```rust
ImageFormat::Png => {
    // Generate SVG first
    let svg_content = generate_svg_string(project, options)?;
    
    // Parse and render with resvg
    let tree = usvg::Tree::from_str(&svg_content, &usvg::Options::default())?;
    let pixmap_size = tree.size().to_int_size();
    let scale = options.dpi as f32 / 72.0;
    
    let mut pixmap = tiny_skia::Pixmap::new(
        (pixmap_size.width() as f32 * scale) as u32,
        (pixmap_size.height() as f32 * scale) as u32,
    ).ok_or("Failed to create pixmap")?;
    
    resvg::render(&tree, tiny_skia::Transform::from_scale(scale, scale), &mut pixmap.as_mut());
    pixmap.save_png(path)?;
}
```

### 4. Depth Colors in SVG Generation
Modify `generate_svg_string()` to use depth colors when `color_mode == Depth`:

```rust
// For each station
let color = match options.color_mode {
    ColorMode::Section => section.color.clone(),
    ColorMode::Depth => get_depth_color(
        station.coordinates.z,
        depth_range.min,
        depth_range.max,
        options.depth_preset.unwrap_or(DepthPreset::Thermal),
    ),
};
```

### 5. Depth Legend SVG Element
When `include_legend == true` and `color_mode == Depth`:
```rust
fn generate_depth_legend(
    min_depth: f64,
    max_depth: f64,
    preset: DepthPreset,
    unit: &str,  // "m" or "ft" from config
) -> String {
    // Returns SVG group with:
    // - Vertical gradient bar (16x80px)
    // - Min depth label at top
    // - Max depth label at bottom
}
```

### 6. Update ExportDialog.tsx
Add color mode and preset selectors:
```tsx
const [colorMode, setColorMode] = useState<'section' | 'depth'>('section');
const [depthPreset, setDepthPreset] = useState<DepthPreset>('thermal');
const [includeLegend, setIncludeLegend] = useState(true);

// Fetch preset colors for preview
const { data: presetColors } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['depth-preset-colors', depthPreset],
  queryFn: () => invoke('get_depth_preset_colors', { preset: depthPreset }),
  enabled: colorMode === 'depth',
});
```

UI additions:
- Color Mode radio buttons (Section Colors / Depth Gradient)
- Depth Preset dropdown (when depth mode selected)
- Include Legend checkbox (when depth mode selected)
- 600 DPI option added to resolution selector

### 7. Extend ExportPreview Component
Add `colorMode` and `depthPreset` props:
```tsx
interface ExportPreviewProps {
  options: ExportImageOptions;
  theme: ExportTheme;
  colorMode: 'section' | 'depth';
  depthPreset?: DepthPreset;
  presetColors?: { shallow: string; deep: string };
}
```

When `colorMode === 'depth'`:
- Use `getDepthColor()` from `src/utils/colors.ts` for station/shot colors
- Use `presetColors.shallow` and `presetColors.deep` from backend
- Zero-datum stations keep gold fill regardless of color mode

### 8. Progress Integration
Use fn-10-i64's LoadingProgress infrastructure:
```rust
// In export command
app_handle.emit("loading:progress", LoadingProgress {
    stage: "Generating SVG".to_string(),
    percent: 30,
    message: Some(format!("Processing {} stations", station_count)),
})?;
```

### 9. Unit Formatting
Read `config.units.depth` for legend labels:
```rust
let unit_suffix = match config.units.depth {
    LengthUnit::Meters => "m",
    LengthUnit::Feet => "ft",
};
```

## Edge Cases

| Case | Handling |
|------|----------|
| All stations at same depth | Legend shows "X.Xm (Flat)", solid color |
| No depth data (all z=0) | Depth mode still works, shows all shallow color |
| Very large project | Progress indicator shows station count |
| Export cancelled | Clean up partial file |
| Invalid preset | Default to Thermal |

## File References

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `src-tauri/src/export/image.rs` | Backend SVG/PDF/PNG generation |
| `src-tauri/src/export/depth_colors.rs` | NEW: Depth color presets and HSL interpolation |
| `src-tauri/src/commands/export.rs` | Tauri export commands |
| `src/components/Dialogs/ExportDialog.tsx` | Export dialog UI |
| `src/components/Dialogs/ExportPreview.tsx` | Preview component |
| `src/utils/colors.ts` | Frontend getDepthColor (from fn-5-jef) |
| `src/types/commands.ts` | ExportImageOptions TypeScript type |
| `src/types/config.ts` | UnitsConfig for depth unit |

## Quick commands
```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Rust tests
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

# Unit tests
pnpm test

# Playwright E2E
pnpm test:ui
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Color mode dropdown in export dialog (Section Colors / Depth Gradient)
- [ ] Depth preset selector with 5 presets (thermal, ocean, terrain, grayscale, accessible)
- [ ] Include Legend checkbox when depth mode selected
- [ ] ExportPreview updates colors when mode/preset changes
- [ ] PNG export works via resvg rasterization
- [ ] 600 DPI option available for PNG
- [ ] SVG/PDF exports include depth colors when selected
- [ ] Depth legend appears in export when enabled
- [ ] Legend shows units from config.units.depth (m or ft)
- [ ] Progress indicator during export (requires fn-10-i64)
- [ ] Zero-datum stations keep gold fill in depth mode
- [ ] HSL interpolation uses shortest hue path
- [ ] Accessible preset uses Viridis-inspired colors
- [ ] Rust unit tests for depth color module
- [ ] TypeScript unit tests for ExportPreview with depth mode
- [ ] Playwright E2E tests for export dialog with color modes
- [ ] WebdriverIO tests for accessibility
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `cargo test` passes

# fn-11-6w4.2 Extend ExportImageOptions with color mode, preset, and legend fields

## Description
Extend ExportImageOptions struct in both Rust and TypeScript to support color mode, depth preset, and legend options.

**Depends on:** fn-11-6w4.1 (depth color module)

## Rust Changes

### Update `src-tauri/src/export/image.rs`
```rust
use super::depth_colors::DepthPreset;

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
#[serde(rename_all = "lowercase")]
pub enum ColorMode {
    #[default]
    Section,
    Depth,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct ExportImageOptions {
    // Existing fields
    pub format: ImageFormat,
    pub dpi: u32,
    pub include_satellite: bool,
    pub include_grid: bool,
    pub include_labels: bool,
    pub include_section_names: bool,
    pub include_shot_data: bool,
    
    // NEW fields
    #[serde(default)]
    pub color_mode: ColorMode,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub depth_preset: DepthPreset,
    #[serde(default)]
    pub include_legend: bool,
}
```

Update `Default` impl:
```rust
impl Default for ExportImageOptions {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            format: ImageFormat::Png,
            dpi: 300,
            include_satellite: true,
            include_grid: false,
            include_labels: true,
            include_section_names: true,
            include_shot_data: false,
            color_mode: ColorMode::Section,
            depth_preset: DepthPreset::Thermal,
            include_legend: true,
        }
    }
}
```

## TypeScript Changes

### Update `src/types/commands.ts`
```typescript
export type ColorMode = 'section' | 'depth';
export type DepthPreset = 'thermal' | 'ocean' | 'terrain' | 'grayscale' | 'accessible';

export interface ExportImageOptions {
  format: ImageFormat;
  dpi: number;
  include_satellite: boolean;
  include_grid: boolean;
  include_labels: boolean;
  include_section_names: boolean;
  include_shot_data: boolean;
  // NEW
  color_mode: ColorMode;
  depth_preset: DepthPreset;
  include_legend: boolean;
}
```

### Update default state in ExportDialog.tsx
```typescript
const [imageOptions, setImageOptions] = useState<ExportImageOptions>({
  format: 'png',
  dpi: 300,
  include_satellite: false,
  include_grid: false,
  include_labels: true,
  include_section_names: true,
  include_shot_data: false,
  color_mode: 'section',
  depth_preset: 'thermal',
  include_legend: true,
});
```
## Acceptance
- [ ] `ColorMode` enum added to Rust with Section and Depth variants
- [ ] `ExportImageOptions` has `color_mode: ColorMode` field with `#[serde(default)]`
- [ ] `ExportImageOptions` has `depth_preset: DepthPreset` field with `#[serde(default)]`
- [ ] `ExportImageOptions` has `include_legend: bool` field with `#[serde(default)]`
- [ ] Default impl sets `color_mode: ColorMode::Section`
- [ ] TypeScript `ColorMode` type matches Rust enum
- [ ] TypeScript `DepthPreset` type matches Rust enum
- [ ] TypeScript `ExportImageOptions` interface has all new fields
- [ ] ExportDialog default state includes new fields
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` passes
